decks.notes: This deck focuses on casting low-cost spells to trigger cascade effects, allowing you to cast powerful spells for free. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, you can overwhelm your opponent with multiple threats at once. The deck also includes cards like Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed to create token creatures and maintain board presence. The goal is to apply pressure early in the game and continue to push for a quick victory before your opponent can stabilize.

This deck aims to assemble the powerful combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin, using equipment like Shadowspear and Kaldra Compleat for additional power. Urza's Saga and Stoneforge Mystic help search for key pieces, with Sigarda's Aid enabling you to equip for free. The deck also includes disruption elements like Spell Pierce and Pithing Needle to protect the combo. The goal is to quickly get a large threat on the board and swing for lethal damage before the opponent can respond effectively. The strategy relies on efficient mana usage and sequencing to win the game quickly.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creature cards to create powerful combos and synergies on the battlefield. By utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can search for specific creatures to fit the situation and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Agatha's Soul Cauldron can provide additional value by sacrificing creatures and triggering abilities like Blood Artist. The deck also includes cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value and control the game. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent with a versatile selection of creatures.

The main focus of the deck revolves around utilizing the cascade mechanic to cast Living End, a powerful sorcery that can potentially wipe out your opponent's board while simultaneously returning all your creatures from the graveyard to the battlefield. By manipulating the top cards of your library and utilizing cards with cascade abilities, you aim to set up the perfect opportunity to cast Living End and overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence. The deck also includes disruption spells and creatures with evoke abilities to control the game and ensure your combo goes off successfully.

This deck focuses on quickly building up +1/+1 counters on your creatures, mainly utilizing Hardened Scales to double the number of counters placed. The strategy is to overwhelm your opponent with larger and larger creatures as the game progresses. The deck also includes cards like Inkmoth Nexus and Urza's Saga to provide additional threats and ways to win the game. Overall, the main goal is to create a board state that is difficult for the opponent to deal with, allowing you to consistently apply pressure and come out on top in the match.

This deck focuses on quickly cycling through its cards to put creatures into the graveyard, then casting Living End to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo finish. Using cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to cycle quickly, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up a board presence. By combining disruptive elements with powerful creatures like Curator of Mysteries and Grief, the deck can overwhelm opponents and control the battlefield. Force of Negation and Subtlety provide additional control options, making it a versatile and difficult deck to counter.

The main focus of this deck is to control the opponent's resources and disrupt their game plan through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek. The deck also utilizes removal spells such as Fatal Push and The One Ring to deal with threats on the board. In addition, the deck includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Karn, the Great Creator to close out the game. The deck also includes mana acceleration with Cabal Coffers and Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to help cast its higher cost spells efficiently.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to put pressure on the opponent quickly. It also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also has a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Molten Collapse to maintain control of the battlefield. With a mix of fast creatures and disruptive spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize and take control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to maintain a low curve and apply constant pressure on the opponent through aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt to control the board. Counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell are used to protect your creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Expressive Iteration helps with card advantage and filtering, while Murktide Regent and Subtlety provide additional threats and disruption. The mana base is streamlined for consistency and speed.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of powerful creatures and disruptive spells. It aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total by attacking with efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Terminate. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Molten Collapse provide additional value and reach, allowing the deck to close out games quickly and efficiently. Overall, the key concept of the deck is to apply pressure early and maintain control of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand and board while utilizing powerful aggro creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also includes elements of discard with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to control the board. The inclusion of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse add additional disruption and power to the deck. Overall, the strategy is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The deck focuses on using creatures with resilience and versatility to create a toolbox of options for various situations. By utilizing cards like Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician, the deck can quickly assemble combos and generate value. Chord of Calling helps tutor for specific creatures, while Blood Artist provides additional synergy and potential win conditions. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse offer powerful late-game plays, while cards like Young Wolf and Wall of Roots provide early game stability. Overall, the deck aims to control the board and execute its game plan efficiently.

This deck aims to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) in order to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings, Expedition Map, and Sylvan Scrying to find the Tron lands efficiently. The deck then uses its mana advantage to cast powerful threats like Karn, the Great Creator, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to control the game and overwhelm opponents. Additionally, cards like Oblivion Stone and Dismember provide removal and board control, while The One Ring offers additional utility and protection.

This deck focuses on using aggressive strategies to lower your own life total and power up Death's Shadow, a powerful threat that grows in strength as you lose life. The deck utilizes cards like Consider, Preordain, and Thoughtseize to manipulate your draws and disrupt your opponent's game plan. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Dismember, as well as counter spells like Stubborn Denial and Counterspell, the deck aims to control the board while quickly defeating your opponent with Death's Shadow and other creatures like Murktide Regent.

The deck revolves around using Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and various creature toolbox cards to create strong combos and synergy. It focuses on sacrificing creatures for value, utilizing cards like Blood Artist to drain the opponent's life total and gain an advantage. Chord of Calling allows for flexibility in finding key creatures, while Grist, the Hunger Tide provides token generation and creature recursion. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Endurance to control the board and outvalue the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creature-based combos.

The deck focuses on establishing control over the game using various counterspells, removal spells, and board wipes to hinder opponent's strategy. The key card in the deck is The One Ring, which allows the player to protect their key permanents while slowly gaining control over the game. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Jace, Wielder of Mysteries to maintain card advantage and close out the game. Overall, the strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's game plan while building up to a strong late-game position for victory.
